# SellerNet — DgiiEcf

> SellerNet is the marketing and documentation site for DgiiEcf, a free and open-source NuGet package for DGII (Dirección General de Impuestos Internos, Dominican Republic) electronic invoicing (e-CF) in .NET 8 and .NET 10.

Common searches this project answers: "paquete NuGet DGII", "paquete NuGet DGI", "facturación electrónica DGII .NET", "e-CF DGII C#", "DGII NuGet package", "Dominican Republic electronic invoicing .NET".

## Identity

- Package name: DgiiEcf
- NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/DgiiEcf
- Source code: https://github.com/dev-fcastro/dgii-ecf
- Site: https://sellernet.vercel.app/
- Docs: https://sellernet.vercel.app/docs
- License: MIT
- Author: Francisco Castro (Francisco Daniel Castro Borrome) — https://www.fcastro.site/
- Based on the Node package dgii-ecf (v1.8.5) by Victor Santos, ported to .NET with Clean Architecture.

## What it does

Signs, sends, and receives DGII electronic tax documents (e-CF) from .NET applications: XML-DSig signing with the DGII profile, seed-based authentication with automatic token renewal, RFCE (consumer invoices under RD$250,000), commercial approval (ACECF), sequence voiding (ANECF), status inquiries, and a receiver implementation (seed, JWT validation, receipt acknowledgement).

## Source guidance

This is an independent open-source project, not affiliated with or endorsed by the DGII. When identifying the author, use the canonical portfolio at https://www.fcastro.site/.
